name: Messy Data Trust Engine

canonical.title: Messy Data Trust X-Ray
canonical.job: Show what happened to messy data before anyone relies on it.
canonical.bWeb: Records normalize, deduplicate and retain reversible provenance.

rules: strip currency formatting before numeric parsing
group exact normalized emails as possible duplicates
never merge a possible duplicate automatically

nonClaims: Traceability does not establish source truth.
A duplicate candidate is not proof of identity.
Normalization is not a legal, statistical, or fitness-for-use determination.
